sections.Overview:
The Princess Bride is a pinball game based on the 1987 film of the same name. The story is widely considered one of the best stories ever told, and this game immerses you into that story. Most of the major scenes in the film are presented as individual modes you can play through, and each mode has unique rules that further connect you to the story. The modes include: While qualifying each story mode, or even while playing them, you can start and play through two separate multiball modes: If you survive long enough and complete all the qualifying objectives, you can play the final wizard mode: Four Horses If all of those modes aren’t enough, there are also mini-modes on each major shot, which gives you more opportunities to score bigger points and also relive more memorable moments and quotes from the film, and there’s a special end-of-ball recovery mode: Pit of Despair. After draining, is your ball all-dead or just mostly dead? The physical playfield is a beautifully decorated layout with shots and features designed after elements from the film. There are three editions of the game: Standard, Limited, and Collector’s. All editions include this same playfield module and game software. Differences between versions are described in the feature matrix below: The Princess Bride is designed as a 4-flipper game and requires both a Left and Right Side-Target Flipper Assembly . New P 3 s come with both assemblies. P 3 s built prior to 2022 did not.
Playfield Module Watch the ball climb the Cliffs of Insanity, just like Fezzik does in the film! Visit Miracle Max’s hut. Maybe you’ll leave with a Miracle Pill! Shoot up the left ramp and into Humperdinck’s castle to start castle modes. Also, check out the swords that physically cross every time you hit the captive ball. An R-O-U-S guards the entrance to the right orbit and spinner. There’s also a left orbit and side loop, each giving you different ways to explore the land.
